title: [DBA-3892] TeachPoint/Eval+ PROD Aurora MySQL Right Sizing (↑ Busy Season)
note:
Hi team, we are planning to upsize the TeachPoint/Eval+ Production database for busy season.
Change: TeachPoint/Eval+ Production Aurora MySQL writer and reader
db.r8g.4xlarge → db.r8g.8xlarge
Instances:

  *   tp-prod-acmh-aurora-09 — Writer
  *   tp-prod-acmh-aurora-10 — Reader

Pythian will perform the resize and controlled Aurora failover. We’ll validate application connectivity, replication/database health, and performance following the change.
Expected impact: Brief application interruption during failover.
Ticket: DBA-3892
Please join for execution/validation as needed.
Thanks!
Laura
